capability.description: Diagnose lead-generation evidence and design bounded acquisition experiments.

hypothesis_template: Because the current qualified-lead count is {current} against a target of {target}, and the observed conversion rate is {conversion_rate}, the next bounded move is to diagnose the funnel before designing one measurable acquisition experiment.

steps.title: Diagnose the qualified-lead funnel
steps.rationale: Separate traffic, conversion, and offer constraints using the supplied evidence.
steps.expected_output: A cited funnel diagnosis with the primary constraint and confidence level.

steps.title: Design one bounded acquisition experiment
steps.rationale: Turn the diagnosed constraint into a measurable test without publishing or spending.
steps.expected_output: An experiment brief with audience, offer, channel, metric, stop condition, and proposed budget requiring approval.
